lines.zh: 我走得不快，但我一直在走。
lines.en: I do not walk fast, and I never stop.
The corner shadow shifted an inch.
I keep to the edges, never the middle.
I cross the floor and the boards stay silent.
I close in block by block.
When you look back, I stop.
My body is wider than the door.
I squeeze through the doorframe.
Each step dims the lamp.
I make one circuit of the room.
I stand with no breath.
I'm stalking and you haven't noticed.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的角落，我占了。
lines.en: This corner is occupied.
The bulb flickers; I wait for it to die.
My shadow moves before I do.
I have this room memorized.
My limbs are the wrong length.
Can you hear me?
I count to sixty.
The door is still behind you.
I have stood a long while.
That breathing is not mine.
You should be asleep.
I see you looking.

lines.zh: 你的手按着门把不肯松。
lines.en: You grip the handle and won't let go.
Don't turn off the light; I want to see you.
We are a little close.
I am at the corner of your sight.

lines.zh: 你数一数房间里有几个人。
lines.en: Count how many are in the room.
I am a little nearer than before.

lines.zh: 你的影子后面还有东西。
lines.en: There is something behind your shadow.
Can you make out my face?
I show more teeth than mouth.
This is not a dream.

lines.zh: 你每眨一次我就近一点。
lines.en: Every blink brings me a little closer.
This house does not welcome you.
You heard something.
The wall is right behind you.
You hit me. I stepped back.
That tore something open.
See? Even I feel pain.
I withdraw into the corner.
Something seeps from the shadow.
I am still right here.
You have strength. Good.
Pain? This body can still feel it.
What are you holding that up for?
I do not eat.
Put it down and leave.
It trembles in your hand.
I need no bait.
I do not like that smell.
Too late.
I will take it. You step back.
You recoiled.
I take a step back and let you pass.
Do not touch me.
I am taller than you thought.

lines.zh: 我贴着角落，慢慢跟着你。
lines.en: I hug the corners and follow slowly.

lines.zh: 这一下，你听见骨头响了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear the bone crack?
The corridor is too narrow.
We cannot both pass.
There is no such thing here.
I only stand.
There is another me in the corner.
It is the same as I.
We do not speak.

lines.zh: 我们只是分担这间屋子。
lines.en: We only share this room.
Two shadows, one corner.
Which one are you watching?
Neither of us is there now.
I pick it up and slip it in your pocket.
It shrank in my hand.
I will not give it back.
I set it by your pillow.
I am there while you look for it.
It is gone.
You put it there yourself.
Count your things. How many are missing?

lines.zh: 错的房间，我却找到了你。
lines.en: Wrong room, and yet I found you.
Running here does not help.
I stood outside the door a long while.
When I move, I move fast.

lines.zh: 你看见的那一面，是正面。
lines.en: The side you see is the front.
Last warning.
You chose this room.
Then I will not be polite.
Do not run.
Running changes nothing.
My fingers are starting to lengthen.
You should not have opened that door.
You are behind the table.
You back to the corner of the bed.
One stride crosses half the room.
What you hear is wind.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸第六次变浅了。
lines.en: Your sixth breath came out shallower.
You tremble, and the bed creaks.
My hand is reaching.
It is longer than my body.
You closed your eyes.
Closing them will not help.
I am under your bed.
I was always here.
Roll over, and I am beside you.
You dare not look.
Looking or not, it is the same.
One step closer and you'll touch me.
Your hand touched me.
There.

lines.zh: 我的手已经搭在你肩上。
lines.en: My hand is already on your shoulder.
It grips into your collar.
I tighten, slowly.
You cannot scream.
I drag you one step.
And I let go again.
Do not make a sound.

lines.zh: 我的手指太长，抓得很牢。
lines.en: My fingers are too long, and grip tightly.
You are pulled into the dark.

lines.zh: 这一下，你的肩就动不了了。
lines.en: After that, your shoulder will not move.
The lamp dimmed for a moment.
A shadow appeared in the corner.
There is a delay before I come.
I appear in the mirror first.
This room is empty. Good.
I am in the corridor outside.
The temperature dropped a little.
All the doors here are shut.
I count how many rooms.
Your lamp is still bright enough.
I will come in and wait.
The wind stopped, and the sound.
I chose this corner.
You have not noticed yet.
I stand outside the door, still.
In a moment, you will hear it.
I rise up from under the bed.
I appear right against the back of your head.

lines.zh: 火光照亮了我，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Firelight shows me. I dislike it.
I land on all fours.
Water enters my body. Cold.
The blast scatters me for an instant.
Something is lodged in my chest.
This sigil holds me still.
I am hungry, but I will not die.

lines.zh: 雷照亮整间屋子，我退到墙里。
lines.en: Lightning floods the room and I sink into the wall.
No floor below — I'm still falling.
